items.text: Government job options for MBA graduates include management trainee posts in public sector units, officer roles in public sector banks and regulators, civil services and state services, and specialised management posts in public bodies, and all are reached through official recruitment with tests and interviews.
List the bodies that recruit MBAs, check each notice for eligibility, prepare for the tests and keep a private-sector backup.
Use only official recruitment websites and verify every notice.
